title: Polarity-flipping scan of a clause
statement: For every clause $C$ of literals with natural-number indices and every bit string $r$, scanning the encoding of $C$ followed by $r$, starting in the clause state, gives the encoding of the clause obtained by negating each literal's polarity, followed by the scan of $r$ starting in the formula state.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a clause of literals with natural-number indices
replaced:
For every clause $C$ and binary string $r$, the polarity-flipping scan from the
clause-level state of the formula syntax scanner maps the serialization of $C$
followed by $r$ to the serialization of the clause obtained from $C$ by negating every
literal's polarity, followed by the polarity-flipping scan of $r$ from the
formula-level state.
